title: Riso Plates
description: A gig poster printed as a two-colour risograph in fluorescent pink and medium blue on uncoated stock. Slide the plates by hand: overlaps go purple, misregistration throws offset halos, and at perfect registration the marks line up and it clicks into place.
intent: One print process finished to the edge: two real ink plates with their own grain and drum streaks that you physically push in and out of register.
